watches.name: McMaster "Maroon" Special Edition James
watches.description: Specs & Details A special edition of our signature James model, the McMaster “Maroon” is a limited-run automatic watch created in tribute to Locke & King’s hometown university. Inspired by McMaster’s iconic colours and campus legacy, the Maroon carries the ruggedly-elegant character of the James while giving it a distinctly McMaster identity. Built as an heirloom-worthy everyday watch, it is designed for alumni, students, faculty, staff, and anyone with a lasting connection to the McMaster community. Only 50 McMaster “Maroon” watches have been made. Beginning June 15 , the McMaster “Maroon” will be available for purchase in-person only at the McMaster University Campus Store , with online sales to follow shortly after. To reserve yours, email Ryan@lockeandking.ca. Size: 42mm Thickness: 12.4mm Crystal: Sapphire Crystal Domed, with AR coating Movement: Miyota Automatic Case: Two-halves, affixed with screws, 316L Stainless Steel Water Resistant: 5ATM Crown: Screw Down Swiss luminous detail on hands Molded case back with unique serial number on each watch Red-tipped second hand referencing the needle on a compass, indicating Northern Time In the event you should lose or misplace your watch, consider joining our LK Society . Created in tribute to the revered university that calls our hometown home, the James, McMaster Edition honours nearly 140 years of discovery, excellence, and quiet impact. Founded in 1887, McMaster University has shaped generations through research, teaching, service, and an unmistakably Hamilton spirit: ambitious, hardworking, and grounded. Like the James itself, McMaster carries its legacy without needing to shout. Ruggedly elegant, quietly confident, and built for everyday life, this limited edition watch celebrates a university, a city, and a community that continue to earn their reputation day by day.

watches.name: Eighty-Sixes
watches.description: It's 1986. Your morning starts with an Orange Julius at the mall, sleeves rolled up on your pastel blazer, before throwing on your shades, hopping into your convertible Corvette and heading to the airfield to fly a jet down south. Now, in a Central American jungle, you're a contract mercenary hunting an unidentified life-form that's also hunting you. You hope to finish the job in time to catch "You've Lost That Loving Feeling" at the pilots karaoke bar back home. Your Eighty-Sixes keep the light out of your eyes as you stare into the jungle. Durable Alloy Frames Flexible Spring Hinges Tri Acetate Cellulose (TAC) Polarized Lenses 100% UVA and UVB Protection

watches.name: Sixty-Threes
watches.description: It's 1963. You rev the motorcycle, ready for another take of the spectacular stunt you're doing as a stand-in for this new WWII film. The plot's still a mystery to you, but the thrill of the ride through these rolling green hills is enough. As you speed through the set, the wind catches your leather jacket and your utility-shades reflect the admiration of the crew. You can't help but think how much you love these Sixty-Threes. Alloy Metal Frame 100% UVA and UVB Protection

watches.name: Ninety-Ones
watches.description: It's 1991. Your oversized patterned shirt flutters as your chunky basketball sneakers pedal your 10-speed through Greenwich Village to see a new Culture Jamming exhibit at your friend's indie gallery. Outside the record store nextdoor a teenager on a skateboard blasts Naughty by Nature from a cassette in his boombox. He ollies as you chain-lock your bike, flip up the shades on your Ninety-Ones, and stroll into the gallery, taking a sip of red wine from a styrofoam cup. 100% UVA and UVB Protection Alloy sunglass frame

watches.name: Sightseers
watches.description: These slim, sleek, simple shades with classic influences are made for those moments strolling down a street in your fave city on a Saturday afternoon, leisurely munching on an apple you picked up at an open-air farmer's market. Find a spot at a sunny patio, order a negroni and people watch, giving an easy wave to friends passing by like you're Marcello Mastroianni living LA Dolce Vita. Sightseers are made for those moments. Protection level: UV400
